items.q: Which pack should I start with?
items.a: If you are new to this, start with a quick-win pack and get one job off your plate. If you already build your own systems, the blueprints are for you. If you run an agency and want everything, take the master suite.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: The quick-win packs are written for people just starting. The blueprints and the suite assume you are comfortable setting up tools yourself.
